items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: She started going with Joe Guy, who was a trumpet player, and eventually they married.

ctx.x: I think... That's once he started... I think.

Although some people say that was... She started going with Joe Guy, who was a trumpet player, and eventually they married. But nobody is sure about that. So she and Lester, did they see like old friends?

Oh yeah, they were buddies, right away. It was really great to watch. We used to have them come over to the house, you know, after work; they'd both come there, and she'd sing. She gave us... They had pictures outside, you know, with cardboard on the back. I used to rip them off and take them home. She'd sign them. I've still got them framed. But somebody stole my picture of Lester Young. I don't know why. It says... He started out, he says, 'Lester Young to Jimmy, my friend.' And somebody ripped it. And somebody…
